segments.source: Overview
segments.normalizedSource: Overview
segments.contextBefore: Find the cause of your bugs by watching variables change as you step through your source code in the debugger.
segments.contextAfter: If the root cause of a bug isn’t immediately obvious when inspecting your source code, watching your variables change as you step through the code helps you isolate where the bug is occurring so you can investigate the possible cause for it.
segments.documentTitle: Stepping through code and inspecting variables to isolate bugs
